The [[Deldrimor Spear]] was introduced in the [[Game updates/20080424|April 24, 2008 game update]] and is part of the Deldrimor set. It is inscribable.

==Acquisition==
Crafted by [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]] for: 10 {{plat}}, 10 {{Deldrimor Steel}}, and 10 {{steel}}.

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]] 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:[[Inscription]]: None

==Dye==
Dye affects the wrappings near the back of the spear. The default color can be closely replicated using brown or yellow dye.
